_about: Golden corpus of CI-runtime failures for the offline Medic eval harness (evals/).
Each case is a realistic failing-CI log reconstructed from the documented failure classes
(DEMO_MISTAKES.md, CLAUDE.md) and the Medic's own routing signatures (agents/medic.py:
(agents/tools.py: _EVIDENCE_MARKERS). The real self-heal commits in git history are fix-only
(no triggering CI logs are stored), so the trigger logs here are synthesised to match the
exact strings the deterministic router keys on — that is what the router actually sees.
Fields: id, failure_class, provider, trigger_log (the CI log the Medic fetches),
('pass' = request_fix accepts it as a real failure | 'reject' = no error marker, refused),
The harness (evals/harness/) scores expected_owner against the REAL medic routing functions
and evidence_gate against the REAL request_fix tool — a regression net for the whack-a-mole
routing/guard logic that previously had no eval.
